coaching.coaching: Add a regression test covering multi-inbound-edge aggregation in inbound_deps_state.
coaching.subject: multi-inbound-edge aggregation in inbound_deps_state

dropped.checklist_item: - [ ] Add a test with ≥2 inbound edges to one target (e.g. two different blockers, or blocks + depends_on) asserting all entries appear in sorted (from_id, relation) order.
evidence: _blocks_pair creates exactly one A--blocks-->B edge; every assertion compares against a single-element list, e.g. `assert [(e["from_id"], e["relation"]) for e in inbound] == [(a, "blocks")]` (test_show_inbound_deps.py:49)

inbound_deps_state iterates and returns a list whose ordering comes from `inbound_links.sort(key=lambda e: (e["from_id"], e["relation"]))` (src/rebar/reducer/_inbound.py:118) — sort/aggregation across ≥2 sources is never triggered by the fixtures
ABSENCE: no fixture links two or more distinct source tickets to a single target, so multi-entry collection + deterministic ordering (a behavior this diff surfaces) has no regression guard
Commit message: 'reciprocal relates_to entries are deduped by the existing derivation.'

find_inbound_relationships suppresses the reciprocal half via `if rel in _SYMMETRIC_RELATIONS and (cand, rel) in own_symmetric: continue` (src/rebar/reducer/_inbound.py:114), with _SYMMETRIC_RELATIONS = {"relates_to"} (src/rebar/reducer/_inbound.py:36)

ABSENCE: the new tests only use `blocks` and `discovered_from`; no relates_to link is created, so the dedup branch and status enrichment on a symmetric relation are untested and a regression there would go undetected
show_state default is `include_inbound: bool = False` (src/rebar/_engine_support/reads.py:306) and only adds the key when True (reads.py:326-330)
New tests only assert the include-True surfaces (CLI default view via subprocess, MCP show_ticket) — none call rebar.show_ticket(tid) at its default to assert inbound_deps is absent
ABSENCE: a regression flipping the default to True (making hot internal callers pay the corpus scan and changing the library show==list==search shape) would not be caught by this suite
dropped.finding: No test exercises more than one inbound edge, so the sorted aggregation in inbound_deps_state/find_inbound_relationships is unverified: a regression that dropped a second inbound blocker or misordered the list would pass every new test.
merged_from: The commit claims reciprocal relates_to entries are deduped by the derivation, but no test exercises any symmetric (relates_to) inbound edge — neither the dedup-suppression path nor status enrichment for a symmetric relation is verified.

No test asserts the library/in-process default path (include_inbound=False) OMITS inbound_deps, so the claimed 'internal hot callers pay nothing' / default-off contract is unguarded from the observable side.
dropped.suggested_fix: Add a test creating C and D both linking to B, and assert show B inbound_deps lists both entries in sorted order with correct per-source status.
